mostWorthwhile.text: Making and releasing collagen was most worthwhile because it connected protein production inside a cell to support outside it. The described sequence was easy to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the body was predictable, though the cutaway helped show that the surface gap remained.

surprise.text: The closed surface did not mean repair was finished: the deeper collagen still needed remodeling and could leave a scar.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The item descriptions gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored a different process or added a more challenging decision. The repair sequence was clear, though most combinations were predictable.
